title: boechera crandallii subsp. thompsonii
intro: Boechera crandallii subsp. thompsonii, commonly known as Thompson's rockcress, is a perennial plant species in the mustard family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and it may be beneficial for relieving stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Boechera crandallii subsp. thompsonii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
